d: The Lakers defeated the Hornets, 118-114 tonight in Los Angeles. Quentin Grimes contributed a team-high 47 points to go with 10 three pointers 6 rebounds and 3 assists, with Luka Dončić of the Lakers adding an additional 36 points (13-34 FG, 5-16 3P) in the game. Brandon Miller finished with a team-high 28 points along with 5 three pointers for the Hornets in the losing effort. The Lakers improve their record to 13-2 with the win, while the Hornets fall to 4-10 for the season.
